frames.title: Dress stone
frames.description: Front-right, behind a sturdy low bench, dressing a squared stone with a broad rasp held in both hands. Cropped grey hair, short SQUARE grey beard, muscular sleeveless grey shirt and brown apron, never long elder beard.

frames.title: Lift stone
frames.description: Front-left, lifting a squared stone block with both hands from a small ground pile, knees bent.

frames.title: Carry ore tub
frames.description: Right-side, carrying a full wooden ore tub at waist height with both hands, entire tub and boots visible.

frames.title: Push stone cart
frames.description: Rear-right, pushing a timber handcart stacked with a few stone blocks, full handcart within cell.

frames.title: Inspect shovel handle
frames.description: Front-right, seated at low repair bench inspecting a cracked wooden shovel handle, short knife and leather binding lying nearby.

frames.title: Fit tool head
frames.description: Front-left, tightening a replacement metal tool head onto a wooden handle at repair bench with a small mallet, both forearms visible.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
